implication: Query syllable channel is oracle-aligned to the target; ASR char channel conflicts. FuzzyPool places the target at distance 0 / mostly index 0. Deterministic syllable/fuzzy rankers therefore approach ceiling on UNSEEN; Stage A does not transfer this signal and instead depends on SEEN-term candidate/query memorization.
note_on_case_A: Case A (deterministic ≫ Stage A on UNSEEN) remains valid as evidence that a term-independent rule exists and Stage A fails to learn it; baselines must not be misread as ASR-only phonetic skill.
